function.name: local.run
function.description:
Execute a saved script by filename in absolute cwd. Save first with script_patch, script_write or local.fs_write. Extensions: .sh uses zsh, .py uses python3, .js/.mjs/.cjs use Bun. Optional args are literal strings. Each execution uses a private snapshot unaffected by later patches.
cwd: absolute path; use the service data directory from System overview unless the user names another directory.
heartbeatSec: optional positive seconds (e.g. 30). If the process is still running when that time elapses, return heartbeat=true, status=running, processId, stdoutPreview/stderrPreview. Then use local.process_status or local.process_stop. If the process exits before heartbeatSec, the call returns the complete result. Without heartbeatSec, the call waits for completion (timeoutMs still applies).
Complete stdout/stderr persist in stdoutPath/stderrPath. Nonzero exit means failure. script_patch must run in an earlier call than this execution.
执行调度：serial（Runtime 固定，不必返回）。

cwd.description: 运行目录的绝对路径；默认取 <overview> 中的服务数据目录。

timeoutMs.description: 可选执行时限（毫秒），省略则不设时限；到期终止进程组

heartbeatSec.description: 可选心跳秒数；进程在该时间后仍在运行则提前返回 heartbeat=true + processId，由模型决定继续查询或停止
